# ankra_cluster (Resource)

Imports and manages a cluster on the Ankra platform. Creating the resource registers the cluster and returns `helm_command`, which installs the Ankra agent; the platform issues that command only once, when the cluster is first registered. Updates re-apply the stacks through the same import route.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cluster" "example" {
  cluster_name           = "dev"
  github_credential_name = "my-github-cred"
  github_branch          = "main"
  github_repository      = "ankra-io/my-repo"

  stacks {
    name        = "ingress"
    description = "Traefik ingress controller"

    manifests {
      name = "traefik-namespace"
      manifest_base64 = base64encode(<<-YAML
        apiVersion: v1
        kind: Namespace
        metadata:
          name: traefik
        YAML
      )
    }

    addons {
      name          = "traefik"
      chart_name    = "traefik"
      chart_version = "37.1.1"
      registry_name = "traefik"
      registry_url  = "https://traefik.github.io/charts"
      namespace     = "traefik"
      parents       = ["manifest:traefik-namespace"]

      configuration = <<-YAML
        deployment:
          replicas: 2
        YAML

      job_configuration = jsonencode({
        create_job_timeout = 600
        update_job_timeout = 600
      })

      # How the platform syncs the addon. Leave the block out to keep the
      # settings made in the portal or with the CLI.
      settings {
        revision_history_limit = 5
        sync_policy {
          self_heal = true
        }
        ignore_differences {
          kind          = "Deployment"
          json_pointers = ["/spec/replicas"]
        }
      }
    }
  }

  timeouts {
    create = "30m"
    update = "20m"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) Name of the cluster. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `github_branch` (String) Git branch that holds the cluster configuration.
- `github_credential_name` (String) Name of the stored GitHub credential used to access the repository.
- `github_repository` (String) GitHub repository (`owner/name`) that holds the cluster configuration.

### Optional

- `ankra_token` (String, Sensitive, Deprecated) Deprecated per-resource API token. Configure the token on the provider block (or the ANKRA_TOKEN environment variable) instead of per resource. Changing it (for example rotating the token) updates the resource in place and never replaces the cluster.
- `stacks` (Block List) Stacks of manifests and addons to apply to the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--stacks))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `wait_for_online` (Boolean) Wait for the cluster agent to check in before the resource is considered created. Defaults to `false`, because importing a cluster only registers it - somebody still has to run `helm_command` against the cluster, which Terraform cannot do. Set it to `true` when that happens out of band and dependent resources need a live cluster.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier assigned to the cluster by the Ankra platform.
- `helm_command` (String, Sensitive) Helm command emitted by the platform to bootstrap the cluster agent. Contains a live cluster agent token, so the value is sensitive.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the cluster (mirrors `cluster_id`).
- `kind` (String) Cluster kind the platform reports.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the cluster belongs to: the provider's `project_id`, resolved to an ID when it is a slug, since the platform shows a cluster only in its own project. Null when the provider sets no `project_id`. Moving a cluster to another project is not managed here; after a move the cluster is no longer visible in this project.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state the platform reports for the cluster, refreshed on every read (`offline` until the agent checks in, then `online`).

<a id="nestedblock--stacks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the stack.

Optional:

- `addons` (Block List) Helm-chart addons deployed as part of the stack. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--stacks--addons))
- `description` (String) Description of the stack.
- `manifests` (Block List) Raw Kubernetes manifests deployed as part of the stack. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--stacks--manifests))

<a id="nestedblock--stacks--addons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks.addons`

Required:

- `chart_name` (String) Helm chart name.
- `chart_version` (String) Helm chart version.
- `name` (String) Name of the addon.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace the addon is installed into.

Optional:

- `configuration` (String, Sensitive) Helm values for the addon, as YAML or base64-encoded YAML. Treated as sensitive because Helm values commonly carry credentials.
- `configuration_type` (String, Deprecated) Ignored; the platform only accepts standalone values.
- `job_configuration` (String) Per-addon job timeouts in seconds, as a JSON object, e.g. `jsonencode({ create_job_timeout = 600, update_job_timeout = 600 })`. Accepted keys: `create_job_timeout`, `read_job_timeout`, `update_job_timeout`, `delete_job_timeout`.
- `parents` (List of String) Stack members that must deploy before this one. Write each as `"manifest:<name>"` or `"addon:<name>"`; a bare `"<name>"` is accepted when exactly one manifest or addon of that name is declared in this resource's stacks, and its kind is inferred. Leaving `parents` unset keeps the dependencies stored on the platform; an empty list removes them.
- `registry_credential_name` (String) Helm registry credential for a private registry. When unset the platform uses the credential connected for the URL, if any.
- `registry_name` (String) Name of the Helm registry as connected to the Ankra organisation. Defaults to a name derived from `registry_url`; the platform accepts any name when the URL matches a registry already connected, and otherwise asks for the registry to be connected first.
- `registry_url` (String) URL of the Helm registry that serves the chart (`https://...` or `oci://...`). Required unless the deprecated `repository_url` is set.
- `repository_url` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of `registry_url`.
- `settings` (Block, Optional) How the platform syncs the addon, the counterpart of `ankra cluster addons settings set`. Without the block the addon keeps the settings it has (set in the portal or the CLI). With it, the settings are written on every apply and each one the block leaves out takes the platform default, so an empty `settings {}` resets every setting to its default. Like the rest of `stacks`, the provider does not read the settings back, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected until the next apply that changes the stack rewrites it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--stacks--addons--settings))

<a id="nestedblock--stacks--addons--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks.addons.settings`

Optional:

- `helm_wait_timeout_seconds` (Number) How long Helm waits for the release to become ready, in seconds.
- `ignore_differences` (Block List) Differences the sync ignores. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--stacks--addons--settings--ignore_differences))
- `keep_failed_resources_for_debug` (Boolean) Whether resources of a failed install are kept for debugging. Default `false`.
- `retry_policy` (Block, Optional) How a failed sync is retried. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--stacks--addons--settings--retry_policy))
- `revision_history_limit` (Number) How many release revisions are kept. Default 10.
- `rollback_on_failure` (Boolean) Whether a failed upgrade rolls back. Default `true`.
- `strict_health_check` (Boolean) Whether the addon counts as healthy only when every resource is. Default `false`.
- `sync_policy` (Block, Optional) Automated sync behaviour. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--stacks--addons--settings--sync_policy))
- `sync_window` (Block, Optional) When the addon may sync. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--stacks--addons--settings--sync_window))

<a id="nestedblock--stacks--addons--settings--ignore_differences"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks.addons.settings.ignore_differences`

Optional:

- `group` (String) API group of the resources.
- `jq_path_expressions` (List of String) jq path expressions of the fields to ignore.
- `json_pointers` (List of String) JSON pointers of the fields to ignore.
- `kind` (String) Kind of the resources.
- `managed_fields_managers` (List of String) Field managers whose changes are ignored.
- `name` (String) Name of the resource.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the resource.


<a id="nestedblock--stacks--addons--settings--retry_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks.addons.settings.retry_policy`

Optional:

- `backoff_duration` (String) Wait before the first retry. Default `5s`.
- `backoff_factor` (Number) Factor the wait grows by. Default 2.
- `backoff_max_duration` (String) Longest wait between retries. Default `3m`.
- `limit` (Number) How many times a failed sync is retried. Default 5.


<a id="nestedblock--stacks--addons--settings--sync_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks.addons.settings.sync_policy`

Optional:

- `auto_prune` (Boolean) Whether resources removed from the chart are deleted. Default `true`.
- `automated` (Boolean) Whether the addon syncs automatically. Default `true`.
- `self_heal` (Boolean) Whether changes made in the cluster are reverted. Default `true`.
- `sync_options` (List of String) Sync options. Default `CreateNamespace=true` and `ServerSideApply=true`.


<a id="nestedblock--stacks--addons--settings--sync_window"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks.addons.settings.sync_window`

Optional:

- `duration` (String) How long the window stays open, for example `1h`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the window applies. Default `false`.
- `schedule` (String) Cron expression the window opens on.
- `timezone` (String) Time zone of the schedule. Default `UTC`.




<a id="nestedblock--stacks--manifests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks.manifests`

Required:

- `manifest_base64` (String) Base64-encoded manifest content.
- `name` (String) Name of the manifest.

Optional:

- `from_file` (String) Source file the manifest was generated from.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace the manifest is applied to.
- `parents` (List of String) Stack members that must deploy before this one. Write each as `"manifest:<name>"` or `"addon:<name>"`; a bare `"<name>"` is accepted when exactly one manifest or addon of that name is declared in this resource's stacks, and its kind is inferred. Leaving `parents` unset keeps the dependencies stored on the platform; an empty list removes them.



<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Clusters are imported by their Ankra platform cluster id.
terraform import ankra_cluster.example 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111
```
